title: transitiontrees — Design Conventions
text: context_tree(..., smoothing = c("floor", "laplace", "kneser_ney", "witten_bell", "jelinek_mercer")) "interpolate" (default) — interpolating rule: distribution zero-count state shifted toward uniform, p_i = (1 - k*ymin)*p_i + ymin, zero lands exactly ymin; fully observed distributions stay raw MLE. gives full-depth machine-precision parity external reference (see PARITY.md). "cap" — original transitiontrees rule: clamp every probability ymin renormalise. Opt-via list("floor", ymin = .., rule = "cap"). "laplace" — additive-α; alpha argument, default 1 "kneser_ney" — back-along suffix path discount D continuation probabilities; canonical prediction suffix trees (Begleiter, El-Yaniv & Yona 2004 §3); discount argument, default 0.75 "witten_bell" — interpolation novelty-based weight "jelinek_mercer" — fixed-λ interpolation order-k order-(k-1); lambda argument Smoothing applied context_tree(). Re-smoothing fitted tree smooth_tree(tree, smoothing) — returns new tree.

what: The boundary: sequences, never aggregated transitions
title: 3. Ecosystem compatibility: TraMineR, tna, and Nestimate
text: hand-works object actually carries sequences. pure graph projection – nodes, edges weights raw sequences nulled (aggregated transition network) – rejected, purpose: original sequences recovered edge weights, fabricating silently wrong. invariant rejects bare numeric transition matrix. tna model built transition matrix alone exactly pure graph: transitiontrees fits raw sequences. aggregated network, go back sequence data built .
code: states <- c("Active", "Average", "Disengaged") transitions <- matrix(c(0.6, 0.3, 0.1,                         0.2, 0.5, 0.3,                         0.1, 0.3, 0.6), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE,                       dimnames = list(states, states)) graph_only <- tna(transitions)   # weights only, no sequences context_tree(graph_only)         # -> informative error, not a fabricated fit #> Error: #> ! This tna object carries no sequence data anywhere (no usable $data / $sequences / $seqdata / embedded netobject). It looks like a pure graph - an aggregated transition network - and transitiontrees fits on raw sequences, not on aggregated transitions: the original sequences cannot be recovered from edge weights (the same reason numeric transition matrices are rejected). Pass a sequence-bearing object instead, e.g. a wide-format transition/network object that still carries its raw sequences, or the original wide sequence data.frame.

code: library(transitiontrees)  # --- Fit ------------------------------------------------------------ # A wide character matrix / data.frame (one sequence per row), or a list # of character vectors. `min_count` is the minimum occurrences a context # needs to get its own node. tree <- context_tree(trajectories, max_depth = 4, min_count = 5,                      smoothing = "floor")  # Smoothing as an explicit list (hyperparameters), or a different scheme: context_tree(trajectories, max_depth = 4, smoothing = list("floor", ymin = 0.001)) context_tree(trajectories, max_depth = 4, smoothing = "kneser_ney")  # From a long event log directly (no manual reshaping): context_tree(group_regulation_long, actor = "Actor", time = "Time",              action = "Action", max_depth = 3) # or build the wide frame yourself: wide <- prepare_input(group_regulation_long, actor = "Actor", time = "Time",                       action = "Action")  # --- Inspect -------------------------------------------------------- print(tree) summary(tree) model_fit(tree)                          # logLik, df, nobs, AIC, BIC, perplexity  # --- Prune ---------------------------------------------------------- # Collapse contexts whose extra depth is not a significant gain over # their parent (likelihood-ratio G^2 test at alpha = 0.05 per context). pruned <- prune_tree(tree, criterion = "G2", alpha = 0.05)  # --- The pathway-centric API --------------------------------------- tree_pathways(pruned)                       # all pathways, sorted by count common_pathways(pruned,    top = 8)         # top by frequency divergent_pathways(pruned, top = 6)         # top by KL from shorter history divergent_pathways(pruned, flips_only = TRUE) sharp_pathways(pruned,     top = 5)         # most deterministic continuations tree_dependence(pruned)                     # per-context entropy/KL diagnostic  # --- Predict & evaluate -------------------------------------------- predict(pruned, newdata = list(c("Active", "Average"), c("Disengaged"))) predict(pruned, c("Active", "Active"), type = "class")   # modal next state logLik(pruned); AIC(pruned); BIC(pruned) perplexity(pruned, newdata = engagement) score_sequences(pruned, newdata = engagement)  # Generate sequences from the fitted tree generate_sequences(pruned, n = 100, length = 20) simulate(pruned, nsim = 100, length = 20, seed = 1)   # S3 alias  # --- Cross-validated tuning ---------------------------------------- tg <- tune_tree(trajectories, max_depth = 1:4, min_count = c(3, 5),                 smoothing = c("floor", "kneser_ney"),                 prune = c(FALSE, TRUE), folds = 5) tg                                          # ranked grid + the best configuration plot(tg)  # --- Group fits and comparisons ------------------------------------ grp <- context_tree(group_regulation_long, actor = "Actor", time = "Time",                     action = "Action", group = "Achiever", max_depth = 2) compare_trees(grp, iter = 200)              # two-tree permutation test compare_groups(grp, iter = 199)             # per-context behavioral + usage tests  # --- Bootstrap pathway reliability --------------------------------- boot <- bootstrap_pathways(pruned, iter = 1000, stat = "count") summary(boot)        # tidy per-pathway stability + informativeness table plot(boot)  # --- Tree introspection -------------------------------------------- query_pathway(pruned, "Active -> Average")   # full predicted distribution pathway_exists(pruned, c("Active", "Average")) subtree(pruned, "Active")                    # restrict to descendants of "Active"  # --- Impute & mine -------------------------------------------------- gappy <- list(c("Active", NA, "Average"), c("Average", "Average", NA, "Active")) impute_sequences(pruned, gappy)                              # fill internal gaps mine_contexts(pruned, state = "Disengaged", min_prob = 0.5)  # where Disengaged is likely mine_sequences(pruned, engagement, which = "surprising")     # worst-fit sequences  # --- Visualisation -------------------------------------------------- plot(pruned)                                # horizontal tree (default) plot(pruned, style = "dendrogram")          # pure-ggplot dendrogram plot(pruned, style = "icicle")              # partition (sunburst) diagram plot(pruned, style = "interactive")         # interactive HTML widget (visNetwork) plot_pathways(pruned)                       # next-move probability heatmap plot_divergence(pruned)                     # per-context KL lollipop plot_distributions(pruned)                  # per-context next-state bars plot_pruning(tree, "Active -> Active -> Average")   # suffix-chain memory view plot_trajectories(pruned, measure = "frequency")    # forward trajectory tree plot_predictive(pruned, engagement)         # text: Non-parametric sequence bootstrap fitted transitiontrees. Methodologically built Saqr, Tikka & López-Pernas (2025), extending edge-level bootstrap framework variable-depth pathways. bootstrap tracks every pathway original tree. iteration resamples whole sequences replacement, aggregates raw counts per depth, reads pathway's count vector directly resample. smoothing, nmin filter, extra parameters inside loop – bootstrap operates counts analogously edge-weight bootstrap. Two complementary measures reported per pathway: p_stability Bootstrap-estimated probability     chosen stat (default count) falls outside     [cr[1] * observed, cr[2] * observed], +1     correction. stability p-value: small values mean     pathway rarely fails chosen reproducibility criterion     sequence-level resampling. stability_rate Uncorrected descriptive companion:     fraction resamples chosen stat lies     inside consistency band. pathway whose count drops zero     resample fails band test automatically. informative_rate Fraction resamples     pathway's empirical \(G^2\) likelihood-ratio statistic     parent context exceeds chi-square critical     value level alpha (df = |alphabet| - 1).     Tests reproducibly significant divergence     shorter-history baseline. Read stable informative together: stable && informative: reproducible predictively     distinctive pathway. stable && !informative: reproducible pathway count /     statistic, predictively distinctive parent. !stable && informative: sharp divergent pathway     carried unstable subset sequences. !stable && !informative: weak sample-fragile     pathway.

text: leaf, compute criterion parent. criterion exceed threshold, drop leaf revisit parent. Repeat stable. root never dropped.
